method.thresholds: strong = at least 15 owner voices, 3 source classes and a 3 year span; recurring theme = at least 5 voices from 3 sources in 2 source classes

notes: Counts are statements extracted from each review, comment or page and grouped by theme. They are not a poll, a rating or a failure rate.
Retailer reviews are seller-collected and skew positive. Where a retailer listing was sampled, the page's own totals are shown above.
Reddit and forum posts are self-selected, and many are people asking for help, so problems are over-represented.
Themes were tagged by a model and the quotes behind them were machine-checked against the source text. Examples link to the original post.

Grace's web pages call this machine the Grace 19X and its manual and warranty page call it the Q'nique 19X; its own product URL now redirects to the Grace home page and only a recertified 19X is listed. No Amazon listing exists for the plain 19X (only 19X Elite bundles with no ratings).
ownerNote: Read the problem counts below with care. Reddit threads about this machine are mostly people asking for help, so problems are over-represented. The retailers' own ratings under 'How we collected this' are the better gauge of overall satisfaction.

documentChecks.label: Throat
documentChecks.juki: 19 in 'throat length' on the web page; 'Quilting Arm width 19 inches' in the manual. Not stated as needle to body.

documentChecks.label: Block size
documentChecks.juki: Up to 17 in on the 19X and 19X Elite product pages; up to 15 in on the Elite feature page.

documentChecks.label: Maximum speed
documentChecks.juki: 2000 stitches per minute (range 90 to 2000 in the manual).

documentChecks.label: Weight
documentChecks.juki: 41.5 lb (18.8 kg) in the manual, body only.

documentChecks.label: Dimensions
documentChecks.juki: Body 26.8 x 15.6 x 32.8 in; quilting arm 8.9 in high, 19 in wide.

documentChecks.label: Motor and power
documentChecks.juki: Peak power consumption 300 W, 110 to 220 VAC; no motor rating or type.

documentChecks.label: Needle system
documentChecks.juki: DPX5 MR, 134 MR or 1955 MR in sizes 14/90 to 20/125; box has size 18 and 16 MR needles.

documentChecks.label: Bobbin
documentChecks.juki: Class M; three in the box.

documentChecks.label: Display
documentChecks.juki: 2.4 in color touch display; the 19X Elite has a 7 in touch display.
documentChecks.others: A dealer page calls the 19X display OLED.

documentChecks.label: Bobbin winder
documentChecks.juki: Built-in bobbin winder and dual thread mast on the 19X (manual).
documentChecks.others: A dealer says the Elite adds a built-in winder.

documentChecks.label: Thread cutter
documentChecks.juki: Hand-used cutter on the hopping foot and one at the bobbin winder; no automatic trim described.

documentChecks.label: Stitch modes
documentChecks.juki: Precise, Cruise, Manual and Baste; Precise and Cruise are regulated.
documentChecks.others: Dealers list regulator plus manual speed mode.

documentChecks.label: Handle controls
documentChecks.juki: Increase, Decrease, Start/Stop and a Needle button per the manual.
documentChecks.others: Dealers describe two buttons per handle.

documentChecks.label: Edge Warning
documentChecks.juki: Edge Warning on the 19X, adjustable to 1 in or 0.5 in; off in Baste mode.

documentChecks.label: Frames
documentChecks.juki: Frame options on the 19X recertified page: Cutie, Q-Zone Hoop-Frame, Q-Zone Queen, Quilter's Evolution frames.

documentChecks.label: In the box
documentChecks.juki: M class bobbins x3, 20 needles, oil, sample thread, maintenance tools.
documentChecks.others: Dealers add bonus kits that are not Grace box contents.

documentChecks.label: Warranty
documentChecks.juki: 2 years on all parts (electronic parts included) and 5 years on the cast metal body; original owner only.
documentChecks.others: A dealer states 5 yr cast body, 2 yr mechanical, 1 yr electrical.

documentChecks.label: Maker price
documentChecks.juki: Recertified 19X $4,999.00 (valued $5,999.00); no new unit listed.
documentChecks.others: Dealers show $5,499 and up by frame option.

documentChecks.label: Availability
documentChecks.juki: Not in the current machine list; a recertified 19X is listed 'while supplies last'.

documentChecks.label: Model name
documentChecks.juki: Q'nique 19X in the manual and warranty; Grace 19X on the web pages.

documentChecks.label: Maker claims
documentChecks.juki: Quoted as claims, not as specs.
